intro.summary: Southwest community along the Elbow River near Elbow Drive, with single-detached homes on generous lots and frequent full rebuilds.
intro.body: Elboya lies along the Elbow River near Elbow Drive and 50 Avenue SW, next to Britannia. Its housing is mainly single-detached homes on generous lots, with some apartments near the main roads. Older homes are commonly replaced by large new single-detached houses.
